bad_at: Patients. Bored by common ailments, impatient with the people who have them. His consultations have shrunk from an hour to a quarter of one; he would rather give five minutes. He calls this efficiency.
carrying: a physician's roll: needles in a bamboo case, a small knife for cutting root
a bronze steelyard and weights, jin and liang
mortar, pestle, three sieves of different mesh
mugwort punk for moxa, wrapped in oiled cloth
a bundle of wooden slips, corded, in his own hand — forty years of case notes
a brush, ink cake, water dropper
two zhu of musk less one grain, in Ji Wan's paper, opened and re-tied
the collar band of the Geng robe, silk lining side, folded in the moxa oilcloth
known_by: West Market: a good physician who does not like you. People come anyway.
Master Dou's tailoring shop: the physician who crossed the market to ask after a cough and lied badly about a draught being taken warm
money_note: Under the floorboard of the stall. Down three hundred and twenty for the musk and two days' takings for the shutter; reopened at midday on the third day.
name: Xu Ping (徐平) — roughly *shü ping*
observed_not_explained: Eleven days ago a patient asked him something he has known since he was twenty, and he had to look it up. It took forty heartbeats. She did not notice.
That evening he cut a slip to open a case record on himself. It sat blank for eleven days.
Belt in one notch since the ninth month.
Appetite poor since autumn. Hunger returned the evening he woke from sleeping a day.
Winded on the lane by the well, and again on the avenue.
No pain, no fever, no swelling, no cough, no blood, nothing on the skin.
His own pulse reads a little slow and a little thin, unremarkable for his age. He does not trust himself to read his own wrist.
The numbness from the aconite outlasted five hours and was gone by morning, unmeasured.
The slip now carries one line: PATIENT WILL NOT SIT FOR THE HISTORY.
Nine aconite roots, sliced, now two days dried instead of one. Untested. The batch he judged at eleven counts is no longer the batch he judged.

Tested himself against twenty slips from the third bundle, twenty years old, drawn at random, first line only with the rest covered. Recalled the case correctly in seventeen, including doses. Could produce the patient name in eleven. Twice produced a wrong name confidently — both times another patient of the same ward with a similar complaint.
The slip now carries a second line: CANNOT DISTINGUISH FAILURE TO IDENTIFY FROM FAILURE TO NAME.

Blind test on thirty-four samples from his own shelf, decanted into squares cut from an old undershirt, numbered inside, eyes shut, each named aloud before looking. Thirty-three named at once. The white angelica root he could describe completely (its uses, its season, a seller of eleven years) but could not name; the name came some minutes later while he was out in the yard, and the slip confirmed it.
situation: Early sixties. Keeps a physician's stall in the West Market, Chang'an. His own man, barely. Mostly a loner.

wants.text: Something is pressing and he has not let himself name it. What it turns out to be gets built out of what he does about it.
